summary: Closed all four T16-final-review findings. F-001 (major): the unattended no-progress stop no longer emits the round-budget terminal reason while both budgets have capacity — TerminalStateReason gained a truthful "no_progress" member and the one misattributing call site now uses it, proven by the reviewer's own unchanged probe (C11 now reports terminalStateReasons=["no_progress"] with 16 rounds/47 calls still unspent) and a new regression. F-002/F-003 stale doc comments were corrected to match T19's actual behavior. F-004's byte-identical duplicate round-ceiling guard was removed with a comment explaining why the entry guard alone suffices. All fifteen reviewer probe cases still pass, the focused agent/budget/child suite is 111 passed / 0 failed (452 assertions), both TypeScript targets exit 0, and ESLint is clean on every changed file.
summary_markdown: All four T16-final-review findings are closed. **F-001 (major)**: added `TerminalStateReason.no_progress` and switched the misattributing call site in `runAgentTurnCore` to it — the reviewer's unchanged `C11` probe now reports `terminalStateReasons: ["no_progress"]` (was `["budget_exhausted"]`) with **16 rounds and 47 calls still unspent**, and a new regression pins this. **F-002/F-003**: stale doc comments corrected to match T19's real behavior (no code change). **F-004**: the byte-identical trailing round-ceiling guard was deleted (a bare `for(;;)` already re-enters the entry guard). Verification: reviewer's two probes 15/15 pass, `bun test` on the three focused files is **111 pass / 0 fail, 452 assertions**, `bun run typecheck` and `bun run typecheck:scripts` both exit 0, and `bunx eslint` is clean on all four changed files.

acceptance.criterion: AC3 (M10): offline stub proves the actual configured round/call budget stops execution with a truthful terminal reason; maxToolCalls is never silently ignored or represented by maxRounds. A stop that no budget caused must not be reported as a budget stop.
acceptance.evidence: The unattended no-progress stop, which is caused by neither budget, now emits TerminalState.reason="no_progress" instead of "budget_exhausted". The reviewer's unchanged C11 probe records providerRequests=4 (roundsRemaining=16 of 20), invocations=3 (callsRemaining=47 of 50), finishReason="no-progress", terminalStateReasons=["no_progress"] — raw .metaproject/data/gdctx/raw/2026-09-06T13-39-29-322Z_run.log. The new regression "T20 F-001: an unattended no-progress stop reports a truthful terminal reason while both budgets still have capacity" (src/commands/agent-tool-call-budget.test.ts) asserts the same invariant directly. All three genuine budget-stop call sites (round-budget entry guard, ask_user interception, tool-call-budget guard) were re-enumerated via `bun src/cli.ts ctx rg -n "emitTerminalState" src/commands/agent.ts` and confirmed unchanged and already truthful.

acceptance.criterion: AC6: independent review reports no unresolved blocker, major or minor findings; the four T16 findings are each closed by an executed regression or a documentation correction the review can verify.
acceptance.evidence: F-001 (major) closed by code fix + new regression + reviewer-probe re-run showing the corrected reason. F-002 (minor, agent.ts offerRoundLimitReset doc) and F-003 (minor, spawn-subagent-tool.ts SubagentCompletionStatus doc) closed by rewriting the stale prose to match T19's actual, already-correct behavior — verifiable by reading the corrected comments beside the code and the passing regressions that exercise those paths (agent.test.ts's cancel-at-round-budget test; the reviewer's D1 probe). F-004 (minor, duplicated round-ceiling guard) closed by deleting the byte-identical trailing block; the reviewer's own probes C1-C11 and the committed budget regressions, all unaffected, are the evidence the entry guard alone already explained every observed behavior.

acceptance.criterion: No behavioral regression: the fifteen probe cases in T16-final-core-budget-probe.ts and T16-final-child-budget-probe.ts still pass, and the focused agent, budget, child and stress suites stay green.
